title: Swordman Aura
description: Elevate your sword combat! Introducing a progression-based aura system with mystical energy, dynamic HUD, and 4 powerful unique skills.
body:
# 🗡️ Swordman Aura - RPG Combat Plugin

Transform your Minecraft server into an epic RPG battlefield with SwordmanAura! This powerful plugin introduces a sophisticated aura-based combat system that rewards skill and progression.

## ⚔️ Core Features

**10-Tier Aura Progression System**
- Start as a Novice and ascend to Divine mastery
- Each tier unlocks unique abilities and visual effects
- Damage multipliers scale from 1.05x to 1.80x

**Dynamic Combat Mechanics**
- Right-click swords for devastating cone slash attacks
- Area-of-effect damage with knockback bonuses
- Energy-based skill system with tactical recharge mechanics
- Hold Shift to rapidly recharge energy (with movement penalty)

**Spectacular Visual Effects**
- Colorful aura rings that match your tier level
- Dynamic slash particles with every swing
- Burst animations on level up and skill activation
- Immersive sound effects for combat actions

**Unique Skills by Tier**
- **Levels 3-4**: Slash Wave - Fire projectile waves
- **Levels 5-6**: Spin Attack - 360° area damage
- **Levels 7-8**: Dash Strike - Teleport strike with explosion
- **Levels 9-10**: Divine Wrath - Lightning storm attack

## 🎮 Gameplay

**Progression System**
- Gain XP from mob kills (+5) and player kills (+Level×10)
- Track separate PvP and PvE statistics
- Climb from Novice to Divine Aura (10 levels total)

**Energy Management**
- Strategic resource system for special abilities
- Fast recharge mode with tactical trade-offs
- Balanced skill costs and cooldowns

## �️ How to Use Aura

**Basic Controls**
- **Toggle Aura**: Use `/aura toggle` command or Sneak + Forward + Right-Click to enable/disable
- **Basic Attack**: Left-click with sword for standard melee attacks
- **Heavy Attack**: Right-click with sword for cone slash attacks (costs 10 energy)
- **Use Skill**: Sneak + Left-click to activate your tier-specific skill
- **Switch Skills**: Press Q to cycle between available skills (when you have multiple skills at higher levels)

**Skill Progression by Level**
- **Levels 1-2**: Basic attacks only
- **Levels 3-4**: Unlock Slash Wave skill
- **Levels 5-6**: Add Spin Attack skill (press Q to switch between skills)
- **Levels 7-8**: Add Dash Strike skill (3 skills available)
- **Levels 9-10**: Add Divine Wrath skill (4 skills available)

**Energy Management**
- Hold Shift to recharge energy 5x faster (reduces movement speed)
- Each skill consumes different amounts of energy
- Strategic energy usage is key to effective combat

## �🔧 Administration

Comprehensive command suite with full tab completion:
- Player commands: `/aura toggle`, `/aura info`, `/aurainfo`
- Admin commands: Level management, XP control, data reset, leaderboards
- Permission-based access control (`swordmanaura.admin`)

## 🌐 Cross-Platform Support

**Hybrid Java-Bedrock Compatibility**
- Full support for Java Edition players
- Enhanced Bedrock Edition support via Geyser/Floodgate
- Unified experience across all platforms

## 📋 Requirements

- **Server**: Spigot/Paper 1.21+
- **Java**: Version 17 or higher
- **Optional**: Geyser + Floodgate for Bedrock support
- **Recommended**: Paper server for optimal performance

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest SwordmanAura.jar
2. Place in your `/plugins` directory
3. Restart server
4. Configure permissions and enjoy!

## 🎯 Perfect For

- RPG and survival servers
- PvP-focused communities
- Servers seeking enhanced combat mechanics
- Hybrid Java-Bedrock environments
- Players who love progression systems

**Version**: 1.0.R  
**License**: Check LICENSE file for details  
**Support**: Comprehensive documentation and active development

Transform ordinary sword combat into an extraordinary RPG experience with SwordmanAura!
